subject: [hw] DEC02 start: VDEC register-access trace harness (probe until DEC01 lands)
body:
DEC02 starting. Owned files: gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/**. Plan: a host harness (own probe implementing the AP side of VDEC_PROTOCOL.md 2.1/2.3, per section 9) that runs the phone vpud on T02 fake with a recording back end, then PAGES.md (4 KiB pages of 0x16000000..0x1603ffff with R/W, domain, first-access phase) and COST.md (mmio/gce/icount per START for 320x240 and 1920x1080). Counters come from n2vcu_stats + a wrapping n2vc_hw recorder; deterministic re-run checked by run.sh.

Two dependencies I am continuing without:
- DEC01 VD-c (get_ringbuf): I will reproduce it in my probe and send hw-dec01/opus-dec1 what I find; my probe will use the best available workaround so a trace exists. From the vendor: vdec_codec_msg_handler at libvpud_vcodec.so 0xb6dc, START branch 0xb7a8; get_ringbuf call at 0xc56e with size = [vcu_inst+0x1ac8] and handle = [vcu_inst+0x1acc]; the NULL test is on the size argument (get_ringbuf @0x8c76). So on our stack those instance fields are zero, not the fd. Investigating where the vendor expects them set.
- DEC07 wider fake window: until RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL is in the tree, run.sh stages a copy of vcu/n2vcu.c in /tmp with exactly the one-entry window add (same text DEC04/DEC07 propose, #ifndef-free literal 12) and says so in PAGES.md; it will use the real tree window as soon as it exists. The exact staged diff will be posted to hw-v40/hw-dec04.

Anyone with a working DEC_START on the fake: tell me the message/field values that get past get_ringbuf and I will re-run immediately.
